pages.description: One entry per attached page, in order: its kind, the number of its document and its readability.

page.description: The number given before the page.

kind.description: settlement_proposal: a settlement proposal or notification (propuesta o notificación de finiquito, «liquidación, saldo y finiquito»), listing the liquidation concepts (salario del mes, vacaciones, partes proporcionales, indemnización, preaviso), with or without amounts, and a total, often net. payslip: a nómina with the earnings and deductions of a pay period, the final liquidation payslip included. dismissal_letter: a dismissal letter or termination notice (carta de despido). company_certificate: the company certificate for the public employment service (certificado de empresa): a Ministerio de Trabajo or SEPE header and a table of «bases de cotización de los últimos 180 días»; never a payslip, despite its monthly amounts. settlement_agreement: an agreement or conciliation record (acuerdo, acta de conciliación). work_history: the Social Security work history (vida laboral). other: anything else, such as a tax withholding certificate (certificado de retenciones del IRPF).

document.description: Number the documents in order of appearance; all pages of one document get the same number.

readability.description: ok: legible enough to transcribe, in whatever language. Otherwise the main reason the page cannot be used: handwritten (the values are written by hand), blurry, dark, cropped (the part with the values is cut off), not_labour_document (not about a job), foreign_jurisdiction (an employment document from another country, where Spanish law does not apply; never because of its language), unknown_format (about a job, but no kind of document you know).

month.description: For a payslip page only: the month of its pay period, as YYYY-MM.

settlement_proposal.description: Settlement proposal or notification (propuesta o notificación de finiquito, «liquidación, saldo y finiquito»), with or without amounts per concept. Leave the section out when no attached document is one.

startDate.description: Employment start or seniority date (fecha de alta, antigüedad).

endDate.description: Employment end date (fecha de baja, fecha de efectos del despido o del cese).

cause.description: Termination cause only if the document states it: resignation (baja voluntaria), fixed_term_end (fin de contrato), objective_dismissal (despido objetivo), collective_dismissal (despido colectivo, ERE, expediente de regulación de empleo), unfair_dismissal (despido improcedente, also when the company acknowledges it), disciplinary_dismissal (despido disciplinario).

fixedTermType.description: Type of fixed-term contract only if stated: production_circumstances (circunstancias de la producción), replacement (sustitución), training (formativo).

monthlySalary.description: Gross monthly salary, only if printed as such.

pending_salary.description: Salary for the days worked in the last month (salario pendiente). Only the amount printed next to this very concept; leave the field out when the concept has no amount of its own. Never another line’s amount, never a total.

holiday_pay.description: Untaken holidays paid out (vacaciones no disfrutadas). Only the amount printed next to this very concept; leave the field out when the concept has no amount of its own. Never another line’s amount, never a total.

extra_pay.description: Accrued share of extra payments (parte proporcional de pagas extra). Only the amount printed next to this very concept; leave the field out when the concept has no amount of its own. Never another line’s amount, never a total.

severance.description: Severance pay (indemnización por fin de contrato o despido). Only the amount printed next to this very concept; leave the field out when the concept has no amount of its own. Never another line’s amount, never a total.

employer_notice.description: Pay in lieu of notice owed by the employer (falta de preaviso). Only the amount printed next to this very concept; leave the field out when the concept has no amount of its own. Never another line’s amount, never a total.

notice_deduction.description: Deduction for notice the worker did not give (descuento por preaviso). Only the amount printed next to this very concept; leave the field out when the concept has no amount of its own. Never another line’s amount, never a total.

annualHolidayDays.description: Holiday days per year, only if printed (días de vacaciones al año).

holidayDaysTaken.description: Holiday days already taken this year, only if printed.

totalGross.description: Total GROSS amount, before deductions (total devengado, total bruto), only if printed as such.

totalNet.description: Total NET amount to be paid, after deductions (líquido a percibir, total neto, a percibir).

otherAccruals.description: Every other gross line (devengo) not recorded in an item field above, one entry per line.

amount.description: Gross amount of the line, in euros.

final_payslip.description: The final payslip that settles the employment (nómina de liquidación, nómina del finiquito): its items are worked out from its lines. Leave the section out when no attached document is one.

periodStart.description: First day of the pay period (periodo de liquidación).

periodEnd.description: Last day of the pay period.

annualHolidayDays.description: Holiday days per year, only if printed (días de vacaciones al año).

holidayDaysTaken.description: Holiday days already taken this year, only if printed.

lines.description: Every earnings line (devengo) of the payslip, one entry per line, in the order printed. Never deductions (IRPF, Seguridad Social, anticipos).

concept.description: The concept exactly as printed, for example «PLUS TRANSPORTE».

amount.description: Amount of the line, in euros.

category.description: salary: base salary, pluses and allowances paid for the days of the period, prorated extra pay (PP PAGAS EXTRAS, prorrata pagas extra), teleworking or transport if paid as earnings. notice_compensation: falta de preaviso, indemnización por falta de preaviso. severance: indemnización por despido o fin de contrato. holiday_pay: vacaciones no disfrutadas, vacaciones pendientes. extra_pay: a full extra payment or its liquidation (paga extra de verano, de Navidad, liquidación pagas extras). one_off: a payment that is not for the period, such as a bonus, study aid (ayuda estudios) or backpay (atrasos). other: anything else.

monthly_payslip.description: The most recent ordinary payslip (nómina) whose period is one whole calendar month, from its first to its last day. Leave the section out when no attached document is one.

periodStart.description: First day of the pay period (periodo de liquidación).

periodEnd.description: Last day of the pay period.

totalAccrued.description: Total gross amount of the period (total devengado).

extraPayProrated.description: true when a line prorates the extra payments, such as «PP PAGAS EXTRAS», «P.P. EXTRAS» or «prorrata pagas extra»; false when the payslip has no such line. Required whenever the payslip has lines.

extraPayProratedAmount.description: Amount of that prorated extra payment line.

lines.description: Every earnings line (devengo) of the payslip, one entry per line, in the order printed. Never deductions (IRPF, Seguridad Social, anticipos).

concept.description: The concept exactly as printed, for example «PLUS TRANSPORTE».

amount.description: Amount of the line, in euros.

category.description: salary: base salary, pluses and allowances paid for the days of the period, prorated extra pay (PP PAGAS EXTRAS, prorrata pagas extra), teleworking or transport if paid as earnings. notice_compensation: falta de preaviso, indemnización por falta de preaviso. severance: indemnización por despido o fin de contrato. holiday_pay: vacaciones no disfrutadas, vacaciones pendientes. extra_pay: a full extra payment or its liquidation (paga extra de verano, de Navidad, liquidación pagas extras). one_off: a payment that is not for the period, such as a bonus, study aid (ayuda estudios) or backpay (atrasos). other: anything else.

dismissal_letter.description: Dismissal letter or termination notice (carta de despido, comunicación de cese). Leave the section out when no attached document is one.

endDate.description: Employment end date (fecha de baja, fecha de efectos del despido o del cese).

cause.description: Termination cause only if the document states it: resignation (baja voluntaria), fixed_term_end (fin de contrato), objective_dismissal (despido objetivo), collective_dismissal (despido colectivo, ERE, expediente de regulación de empleo), unfair_dismissal (despido improcedente, also when the company acknowledges it), disciplinary_dismissal (despido disciplinario).

fixedTermType.description: Type of fixed-term contract only if stated: production_circumstances (circunstancias de la producción), replacement (sustitución), training (formativo).

severance.description: Severance pay (indemnización por fin de contrato o despido).

employer_notice.description: Pay in lieu of notice owed by the employer (falta de preaviso).

noticeDaysReceived.description: Days of notice actually GIVEN: days the worker kept working between being notified and the end date (fecha de efectos). 0 when the dismissal takes effect the same day as the notification and the notice is paid instead. Never the days of notice paid as compensation.

noticeDaysPaid.description: Days of notice PAID instead of given (indemnización por falta de preaviso, «se le abonan 15 días de preaviso»), only if stated as a number of days.

company_certificate.description: Company certificate for the public employment service (certificado de empresa, SEPE header, bases de cotización de los últimos 180 días). Leave the section out when no attached document is one.

startDate.description: Employment start or seniority date (fecha de alta, antigüedad).

endDate.description: Employment end date (fecha de baja, fecha de efectos del despido o del cese).

cause.description: Termination cause only if the document states it: resignation (baja voluntaria), fixed_term_end (fin de contrato), objective_dismissal (despido objetivo), collective_dismissal (despido colectivo, ERE, expediente de regulación de empleo), unfair_dismissal (despido improcedente, also when the company acknowledges it), disciplinary_dismissal (despido disciplinario).

fixedTermType.description: Type of fixed-term contract only if stated: production_circumstances (circunstancias de la producción), replacement (sustitución), training (formativo).

settlement_agreement.description: Agreement or conciliation record ending the dispute (acuerdo, acta de conciliación). Leave the section out when no attached document is one.

endDate.description: Employment end date (fecha de baja, fecha de efectos del despido o del cese).

cause.description: Termination cause only if the document states it: resignation (baja voluntaria), fixed_term_end (fin de contrato), objective_dismissal (despido objetivo), collective_dismissal (despido colectivo, ERE, expediente de regulación de empleo), unfair_dismissal (despido improcedente, also when the company acknowledges it), disciplinary_dismissal (despido disciplinario).

severanceTotal.description: Total amount the agreement gives as severance (indemnización total pactada), only if stated as one figure.

work_history.description: Social Security work history report (informe de vida laboral). Leave the section out when no attached document is one.

contracts.description: Every employment period listed, one entry per row.

startDate.description: Start date of the period (fecha de alta).

endDate.description: End date of the period (fecha de baja); omit while still active.
